note: Push-wave amplitude against settled cruise speed, measured with sim2real.actuator_in_env true (rod v_max 0.28 m/s, a_max 3.5 m/s^2, 50 N stall, 200 W battery, 20 ms bus latency). Reproduce with scripts/skills/calibrate_drive_hardware.py.

hardware.summary: what this build actually does with its own motors

thrust.note: Peak rise of the core in metres from a downward thrust burst, spread 0.55, held for `burn_steps` control steps then tucked. Reproduce with scripts/skills/calibrate_thrust_hardware.py.

hardware.why: a rod capped at 0.28 m/s needs 0.48 s to cross its 0.135 m stroke, so a burst shorter than about 50 control steps never delivers the commanded power
